newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK CBANK SAYS REV REPO RATE FALLS TO 13.26 PCT.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK CBANK SAYS REV REPO RATE FALLS TO 13.26 PCT.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Monday its reverse repo rate for a seven-day securities tender had fallen to 13.26 percent from 14.65 percent.
The NBS added that it had drained funds totalling 2.9 billion crowns through Monday's tender.
The NBS said in a statement the average rate was 13.26 percent, after 14.65 percent in the previous reverse repo tender with a similar maturity on Thursday.
The maximum bid in the tender was 14.5 percent, while the minimum bid rate was 12.5 percent, it added.
The NBS said 2.9 billion crowns worth of bids out of a total 3.175 billion were accepted.
